title: Style Concept
slide_intent: Distinguish the gesture of shopping from the goods it brings within reach. Changes in line and mass let viewers tell action from object.
strategic_value: Instacart can make its Shop and Savor framework visible inside a drawing through light active contours and substantial filled forms.
demonstration: A hand drawn in a thin line sits below Shop. Overlapping colored grocery forms sit below Savor. Separate arrows point from the captions to each example.
practical_value: Use a light contour for movement and filled forms for groceries. Check that each treatment supports what the object or gesture is doing in the scene.

content_islands.name: Framework note
content_islands.spec: Place the title and short explanation at left on the pale field.

content_islands.name: Shop specimen
content_islands.spec: Position the outlined hand under the Shop label and light-line caption. Connect caption and hand with a fine vertical arrow.

content_islands.name: Savor specimen
content_islands.spec: Give the filled produce group a matching caption position and arrow, preserving its overlap and sense of volume.
